knownIssues: MUSD-mode redemptions fall back to wSMUSD shares on any settlement failure, including a relayer-induced out-of-gas when native withdrawals are expensive. Fixed in pending-v2 (not yet deployed).

publicRuns.disclaimer: Executed on Mezo testnet and Base Sepolia with Wormhole testnet guardian signatures.

reusedTransactions.note: These transactions were mined by an earlier attempt that aborted on a stale RPC read before writing evidence. They were adopted after verifying sender, target and function, and every effect recorded above is re-derived from chain state at their blocks.

steps.title: Preflight: chains, pinned vault implementation, peer binding, balances
Approve exact MUSD amount to source gateway (bounded, not unlimited)
Real MUSD → native savings vault → wSMUSD minted → shares locked → ISSUE message published
Guardian-signed ISSUE VAA obtained and parsed
Negative: byte-altered ISSUE VAA rejected by destination (simulation)
Destination verifies VAA, consumes transfer id, mints exact rwSMUSD
Negative: replayed ISSUE VAA rejected (no second mint)
rwSMUSD transferred to a second holder (standard ERC-20)
Two holders burn exact rwSMUSD and publish REDEEM messages (shares mode, MUSD mode)
Guardian-signed REDEEM VAAs obtained (after Base finality)
Negative: Mezo-emitted VAA submitted as a REDEEM is rejected (wrong emitter chain)
Authenticated release: exact wSMUSD to second holder; wrapper redemption to MUSD for primary
Negative: replayed REDEEM VAA rejected (no second release)
Independent reconciliation from chain state
